author: Rombeyy
body:
Sup guys for those of you that don't know the past week i worked editing this map ( with the help of Clijmart and Mepii, ty guys so much for the help!!! ), this map its not going to be released until i get the permissons of the original creator ( i tried to contact him for the past 2 weeks and he is not responding so i dont rlly know what its going to happen with the map) but i still want to know whats the community oppinion on the map ;)

PD: I wanted to leave it as close as possible to the original map

Images: http://imgur.com/a/cqOYc

While the map its preserved, you guys can give me opinions on what should i add or change :)

replies.author: Riilo
replies.body:
I like the wool rooms but you have barely made any changes. Maybe you could add more detail but keep the stalemate, no wood theme. I believe you are trying to revamp this map so you might as well revamp it quite a bit.

I don't know about you but if somebody made my DTM map into CTW with barely any changes I would barely call you a creator.

replies.body:
Hi, just saw your message. Also thanks for Crazy for notifying me.

Clay Wars is a very old map that was made as an expirement. With just the age in mind, I've decided to let it enter the realm of the "dead" and let it sit where it is (at least in the current version) with not changing it and letting it become legacy.

Sorry but I'm not interested in the changes that were done, I did also reply to you on Discord if theres anything else you have on your mind.
